title: Exterior entrance with glass façade and canopy labelled Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing
objects_and_counts: At least four people are visible on the covered walkway at left; some are partially cropped and walking away from the camera (exact identities not inferred).

One person is visible as a reflection on the large glass panels near the center of the image; this reflected person is pictured on the glass surface, not physically behind it in the photographed scene.
Two freestanding lamp posts with spherical/frosted globe light fixtures are visible in the foreground: one near image center and one at right; both posts are fully visible and upright.

A continuous run of exterior glass panels and glass doors forms the ground-floor façade extending from near center to left; individual vertical glass panels are visible but an exact panel count across the full façade is not asserted.
One open entrance / doorway is visible to the right of center, recessed beneath the canopy; its interior appears dark.
One yellow notice/poster is affixed to a vertical glass or pillar element near the center-left of the façade (text on the notice is not legible).
spatial_relations: A metal-and-glass canopy extends along the building façade from left to right above the glass panels and entrances.
The two globe-topped lamp posts stand in the foreground on the tiled plaza; one is roughly centered horizontally in the image and the other is positioned toward the right edge.
The covered walkway continues to the left of the image, where pedestrians are walking away from the camera toward a gap between buildings and some trees visible in the background.

The main glass façade occupies the center horizontal band of the image; an open recessed doorway is located to the right side of that glass band, with a short sloped area or ramp leading down just beyond it.

Brown-brick building elevations rise above and to the right of the glass entrance area; a vertical sign with Chinese characters is mounted on the brown-brick face at upper left of the façade (text not transcribed here).
colours_and_materials: The ground surface is covered in reddish-brown terracotta-like paving tiles laid in a herringbone or linear pattern.
The façade is predominantly clear glass panels with metal framing and a silver/grey metal canopy above.
The building exterior above the glass façade is faced in dark brown or maroon brick tiles.
The lamp-post shafts are dark brown; the light fixtures are spherical and appear frosted or translucent white.
uncertainties: Several small signs and notices (including a yellow poster on the glass) contain text that is not legible at this image resolution and have therefore been transcribed as untranslated/unreadable.
A vertical sign with Chinese characters is visible on the brick facade at upper left but its characters are not legible enough for an exact transcription.
The exact number of glass panels in the continuous façade is uncertain because some panels are partly out of frame and reflections obscure clear panel boundaries.
The count 'at least four people' is a visible minimum; some people are partially cropped or distant so an exact total present in the scene cannot be determined from this single view.
